name: Chitter
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Your Colony makes a loud chittering sound, unsettling your foes. Each time a creature moves within short range of you, you may roll Spirit vs Fortitude against them. On a win, that creature must spend the rest of its available movement moving away from you.

Describe the chittering.
successes:
✨: On a win, the creature takes -1 Defense.

🌞: On a win, the creature checks a Condition.
